source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hey Larry — this sounds great, I like the approach and timeline.

Let’s move forward.

For the first step, I’d like to focus on:
• system layout
• motor + component selection
• basic wiring plan

Goal is to get a working prototype up and running as quickly as possible, then refine from there.

Let me know what you need from me to get started.

value_updates.deliverable: prototype bill of materials for motor and component selection

source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text: I've got the initial BOM ready for you to look at, taking into consideration the recent design elements you mentioned. Some parts, Such as any additional wires, hardware and housing which will be custom fabricated, I already have the material for these my shop and they will be added to the BOM in the future once the build begins. I'll now begin the initial cad design using rough measurements of the components. This will be refined once you approve the components and the purchasing of them so that accurate measurements of each piece can be taken by me to refine the design fully. I've stuck to amazon for all the components so that we can quickly iterate if something needs to be changed or added in the future.

execution.observed_behavior: Freelancer reports that an initial component-level BOM reflecting the recent design decisions is ready for review.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Are you going to send a revised BOM? Also, how do you want to handle payment for the BOM? Do you want me to buy everything and send it to you? Or is the address at the links automatically going to you?

execution.observed_behavior: Freelancer reports that the requested revised BOM has been finalized.

source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text: Newly updated BOM. Only difference between this one and the previous is that the PWM motor controllers have been swapped out for higher power ones. And the AC/DC adapter has been swapped out for a 50A version which should supply more than enough power with reserves to ensure nothing overheats. I also went through and confirmed pricing on everything as there was a few discrepancies in the prices I had listed and the current prices.

execution.observed_behavior: Freelancer reports updating the BOM with higher-power motor controllers, a 50A power supply, and corrected current pricing.

source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text: Hey Karla, yes everything listed is fully compatible with the other components. Including both the power side of things and the mechanicals with the shafts, couplings etc.

execution.observed_behavior: Freelancer confirms that the BOM-listed electrical and mechanical components are mutually compatible.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: BOM approved. Make the orders and I will reimburse you.
